entries.speaker: Confidant Invitations
entries.en: Confidants will send invitations to spend time with[n]them via IM. Some messages will be important.

entries.speaker: Confidant Invitations
entries.en: You can accept the invitation by responding to the[n]message, but there is no need to reply immediately.

entries.speaker: Confidant Invitations
entries.en: Text messages that have not been responded to[n]will have [clr 2]Hold[clr 27] by the message.

entries.speaker: Confidant Invitations
entries.en: Wait too long to respond and the invitation will[n]expire. Not every IM needs a reply. Accept the[n]invitations from people you're interested in.
